action_instruction: Reading the payment link status badge
intent: the payment link status badge text

action_params.query: the payment link status badge text

action_instruction: Checking for the already-used payment link message
intent: whether the already-used payment link message is shown

action_params.condition: The message "This payment link was already used and cannot be paid again" is shown.
action_params.query: whether the already-used payment link message is shown
action_params.code_js: [...el(5).querySelectorAll('.ee-alert.ee-alert--info')].some(e => e.innerText.includes('This payment link was already used and cannot be paid again'))

action_instruction: Checking whether the payment button is disabled
intent: whether the Pay ₹2,500.00 button is disabled

action_params.query: whether the Pay ₹2,500.00 button is disabled

assertion_tree.description: The status badge reads "Paid", the message "This payment link was already used and cannot be paid again" is shown, and the "Pay ₹2,500.00" button is disabled.

sub_results.description: The message "This payment link was already used and cannot be paid again" is shown.

assertion_tree.verification: The current page shows a status badge reading "Paid", displays the message "This payment link was already used and cannot be paid again", and has a disabled "Pay ₹2,500.00" button.
